bridge_panel.meaning: A fixed set of canonical genes representable by the same gene identity in both modality families; it is a fairness interface, not the method name.
construction_order: intersect status=unique canonical_identifier values across P10S1, P10S2, and P10S3
intersect with feature identifiers in all six RNA matrices
intersect with genes having exactly one Ensembl release 79 GRCm38 interval under the frozen Night-12A annotation parser
sort by exact Unicode code-point order
write one UTF-8 identifier per line with a final newline and record SHA-256 before any numeric expression or outcome value is inspected
bridge_panel.final_count: m is determined mechanically by the remaining intersections with all six RNA identifiers and unique Ensembl79 intervals before any numeric matrix is read; no fixed final m is assumed
bridge_panel.mismatch_policy: If the P10-only intersection is not exactly the registered 83-gene list/hash, stop as NIGHT12B_INPUT_PROVENANCE_BLOCKED. If later structural intersections remove genes, record every identifier and structural reason and continue only when m>=3; never replace removed genes or adapt the panel.
bridge_panel.constant_or_zero_features: retain, mark non-identifiable, and report; never silently drop

common_rna.library_sum_scope: all deposited RNA features before bridge-panel selection

RNA_PLUS_ATAC_target.source: official P5 fragments already downloaded and frozen by Night-12A
RNA_PLUS_ATAC_target.link_formula: gene body plus strand-aware 5 kb upstream; for every selected gene interval containing the fragment midpoint, add fifth-column multiplicity to that gene (overlapping selected-gene intervals may each receive the same fragment, exactly as in the frozen Night-12A parser)
RNA_PLUS_ATAC_target.claim_boundary: clean-room score; not numerically equivalent to ArchR GeneScoreMatrix
RNA_PLUS_ATAC_target.join: exact canonical barcode join within each replicate; preserve and report all pre/post counts

RNA_PLUS_PROTEIN_target.source: official P10 ADT matrix already downloaded and frozen by Night-12A
RNA_PLUS_PROTEIN_target.transform: For each spot and all deposited ADT targets, denominator = exp(sum(log1p(count_target))/number_of_targets), output_target = log1p(count_target/denominator); then select the structurally frozen bridge targets. Do not apply global feature scaling before outer cross-fit.
RNA_PLUS_PROTEIN_target.mapping: only Night-12A status=unique canonical mappings; ambiguous, control, and unmapped targets never enter the bridge panel

coordinate_transform.formula: min-max normalize x and y to [0,1] using that replicate's full coordinate set
coordinate_transform.degenerate_axis: retain as zero after subtraction; report

preprocessing.fold_standardization: For every outer fold, standardize the target and candidate RNA predictor using training observations only; apply those parameters to the held-out block. The fixed spatial basis is not standardized. Zero training variance yields a zero standardized column and is reported.

construction: center the replicate's normalized x,y coordinates
compute the 2x2 covariance and its leading eigenvector
fix sign so the loading with largest absolute magnitude is positive; ties choose x before y
if the leading eigenvalue is exactly tied and the leading vector is not uniquely determined, use the normalized x axis and report the fallback
sort by projection, normalized x, normalized y, then canonical spot identifier
split the ordered observations with numpy.array_split into five non-empty equal-count contiguous blocks
spatial_folds.scope: coordinate-only and fixed before target values are inspected

per_replicate_link_utility.linked: target ~ fixed spatial basis + one candidate RNA gene
per_replicate_link_utility.estimator: ordinary least squares via numpy.linalg.lstsq with rcond=1e-12
per_replicate_link_utility.outer_cross_fit: five fixed spatial blocks; train on four and predict the held-out block
per_replicate_link_utility.candidate_set: all m bridge RNA genes for every bridge target j
per_replicate_link_utility.true_link: g equals the same canonical gene j
per_replicate_link_utility.decoys: all m-1 other bridge RNA genes; exhaustive, no subsampling
per_replicate_link_utility.true_link_empirical_tail: p_link[r,j] = (1 + count over g!=j of u[r,j,g] >= u[r,j,j]) / m
per_replicate_link_utility.tie_policy: ties count against the authoritative true link
per_replicate_link_utility.p_link_note: an empirical exhaustive-decoy rank tail, not a formally calibrated probability
per_replicate_link_utility.implementation_equivalence: residualization or batched linear algebra is permitted only if tests prove numerical equivalence to the frozen per-candidate OLS within absolute and relative tolerance 1e-10

spatial_block_bootstrap.unit_seed: seed_base + first 8 hex digits of SHA256(unit_id) interpreted as unsigned integer modulo 1000000
spatial_block_bootstrap.resampling_unit: the five held-out spatial-block SSE contribution pairs
spatial_block_bootstrap.draw: sample five block indices with replacement and sum their baseline/linked SSE contributions before recomputing all candidate utilities and the exhaustive-decoy rank tail
spatial_block_bootstrap.instability_tail: p_unstable[r,j] = (1 + count over bootstrap b of p_link_boot[b,r,j] > 0.5) / 65
spatial_block_bootstrap.tie_policy: p_link_boot equal to 0.5 is not counted as worse; all comparisons otherwise exact
spatial_block_bootstrap.p_unstable_note: a smoothed block-instability rate, not a formally calibrated probability

leave_one_replicate_out.folds: For each modality family, hold each replicate out once and use only the other two as discovery replicates a,b.
leave_one_replicate_out.score_note: All four are deterministic ranking scores. None is to be described as a calibrated p-value.
leave_one_replicate_out.heldout_isolation: No held-out target values, utilities, ranks, or summaries may influence panel construction, formulas, thresholds, signs, transformations, or tie rules.

evaluation.fold_statistic: Spearman correlation across all m bridge features between a discovery score and held-out Y
evaluation.undefined_or_constant_policy: set correlation to 0.0 and fail closed; report the reason
evaluation.family_pooling: clip each of the three fold correlations to [-1+1e-12, 1-1e-12], take arithmetic mean of Fisher atanh values, then tanh

decision_bootstrap.synchronous_resampling: resample the same feature indices with replacement across all three held-out folds and all four axes within a family
decision_bootstrap.interval: two-sided percentile 95% interval using numpy quantile at 0.025 and 0.975 with method=linear
decision_bootstrap.strongest_single_each_draw: max of pooled link_only, bootstrap_only, and replicate_only correlations

per_family_all_required: combined correlation is > 0 in each of the three held-out folds
95% bootstrap lower bound for pooled combined correlation is > 0
95% bootstrap lower bound for combined minus strongest single axis is > 0
median held-out p_link is < 0.5 in each of the three held-out folds
all six required real units completed with finite registered outputs and no forbidden read/action
strict_scientific_gate.overall: Both RNA_PLUS_ATAC and RNA_PLUS_PROTEIN must pass every per-family requirement. There is no partial overall pass.

formal_freeze_and_corrections.preformal: Implementation and synthetic-test defects may be corrected before formal freeze, with a complete log. No real scientific summary may be inspected to choose a formula or threshold.
formal_freeze_and_corrections.formal_freeze: Hash source, contract, bridge panel, input manifests, fold assignments, and environment before formal evaluation.
formal_freeze_and_corrections.after_freeze: At most one global implementation correction cycle is allowed. It invalidates and reruns all six units, both families, all held-out folds, all axes, and all decision bootstraps.
forbidden_corrections: formula revision after formal values are visible

recompute the registered 83-gene P10-only upper set and then the exact final structural bridge panel (m<=83) before reading numeric matrices
materialize the six bridge-panel RNA/target matrices into the new derived root and verify exact identifiers, row joins, shapes, finiteness, sparse construction, and hashes

run fixed preprocessing -> five-block construction -> one baseline/linked OLS computation -> artifact write -> fresh-process reload on every real unit without printing or using scientific utility summaries
run synthetic controls and equivalence tests for OLS, exhaustive decoys, bootstrap, held-out isolation, and gate logic
verify the complete label and prohibited-action firewall before formal freeze
p0_real_path_gate.failure: stop before formal evaluation and classify according to provenance, implementation, or infrastructure cause
